evidence.summary: 独立开源编码Agent，提供终端、Studio、Web及ACP入口，可由DSH委派任务。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 docs/DSH.md、integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml、internal/safety/permission/permission.go、internal/frontend/acp/cancel_request.go、desktop/frontend-next/src/state/rewind_notice.ts；DSH provider启动reasonix acp并自动答权限，Go Policy/Gate分离规则与交互，ACP requestId有独立取消上下文。[Q02](#research-q02)
limitations: partial clone固定studio源码抽读DSH文档/bundle、Go permission与ACP取消及UI notice；inventory只计支持的MD/TS子集，不把Go遗漏当零规模，未审计整个loop/sandbox/rewind，未执行。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 面向需要本地编码Agent或DSH委派只读研究/评审的开发者；根项目是工具/应用，DSH bundle只是子目录配置。[Q01](#research-q01)
DSH provider启动reasonix acp并自动答权限，Go Policy/Gate分离规则与交互，ACP requestId有独立取消上下文。[Q02](#research-q02)
partial clone固定studio源码抽读DSH文档/bundle、Go permission与ACP取消及UI notice；inventory只计支持的MD/TS子集，不把Go遗漏当零规模，未审计整个loop/sandbox/rewind，未执行。
根为Go编码工具，多前端和1.x/2.x版本线分开；不能用npm维护线包替代固定studio分析。

#### 成本

|阶段|现金与资源|人工与时间|未知|
|---|---|---|---|
|首次|正确发行、模型和ACP包|配置home/key、目录及版本|兼容与配置工时|
|持续|子模型请求和重复上下文|委派、合并与独立测试|总调用成本和收益|
|失败恢复|取消、重试与文件恢复|核对shell副作用及未验证改动|回收/恢复成功率与时间|
先以可丢弃项目和默认reject做只读研究/评审试用，核对真实tool委派、同版provider和模型home；不把正常结束或rewind当完整验收。[Q04](#research-q04)

#### 效果

|效果项|抽读支持|未知|
|---|---|---|
|DSH委派|ACP配置与作者报告|本轮运行兼容|
|权限/取消|Policy分离、request context|所有前端和工具实际行为|
|文件恢复|作者明确编辑工具范围|shell及完整工作区恢复|
纯Policy与Approver解耦、requestId独立取消值得复用；移植必须保留前端默认权限和副作用所有权，不能只复制工具名。[Q02](#research-q02)
本体把编码引擎组织为多前端与权限接口；DSH集成复用ACP以配置完成委派，增量是可用接线而非新协议或宿主保证。[Q01](#research-q01)
自动allow不是逐次人工审批，nil Approver与Ask语义需按前端核对；新进程不共享父会话，rewind不覆盖shell副作用。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03)
未验证假设是父子交换验证命令、修改范围及不可恢复副作用收据，减少正常结束被误当完成验收；对照错误/取消任务的父误判和恢复时间，无改善则否定。[Q04](#research-q04)

technical.rationale: novelty为常见编码Agent多前端适配；mechanism纯权限Policy与协议取消组合有实质工程增量；transferability ACP和配置bundle可迁移但需版本；simplification单引擎多入口及配置委派，实际成本未测。

business.rationale: workflow在父Agent与子工具间委派；delivery仍是需验收代码；reach多前端与模型选择；economics重复上下文和恢复成本未知。

结论状态 抽读支持ACP/权限接线；作者宿主验证未独立复现，完整编码/rewind效果未知；交付收据假设未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：面向需要本地编码Agent或DSH委派只读研究/评审的开发者；根项目是工具/应用，DSH bundle只是子目录配置。[Q01](#research-q01) - **亮点**：本体把编码引擎组织为多前端与权限接口；DSH集成复用ACP以配置完成委派，增量是可用接线而非新协议或宿主保证。[Q01](#research-q01) - **思考**：自动allow不是逐次人工审批，nil Approver与Ask语义需按前端核对；新进程不共享父会话，rewind不覆盖shell副作用。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：未验证假设是父子交换验证命令、修改范围及不可恢复副作用收据，减少正常结束被误当完成验收；对照错误/取消任务的父误判和恢复时间，无改善则否定。[Q04](#research-q04) 采用建议：先以可丢弃项目和默认reject做只读研究/评审试用，核对真实tool委派、同版provider和模型home；不把正常结束或rewind当完整验收。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 本体把编码引擎组织为多前端与权限接口；DSH集成复用ACP以配置完成委派，增量是可用接线而非新协议或宿主保证。[Q01](#research-q01) ## 关键质疑 自动allow不是逐次人工审批，nil Approver与Ask语义需按前端核对；新进程不共享父会话，rewind不覆盖shell副作用。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证假设是父子交换验证命令、修改范围及不可恢复副作用收据，减少正常结束被误当完成验收；对照错误/取消任务的父误判和恢复时间，无改善则否定。[Q04](#research-q04) 隔离项目核查ACP工具注册、reject、取消、错误、未验证暂停标记及编辑/shell差异；同任务比较父误判与恢复工时。 ## 场景与替代办法 面向需要本地编码Agent或DSH委派只读研究/评审的开发者；根项目是工具/应用，DSH bundle只是子目录配置。[Q01](#research-q01) 直接在Reasonix或既有单Agent上执行同任务；委派应以相同模型预算比较交付及交接负担，不以另开进程数证明协作价值。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 |依赖或条件|是否必需|用途|缺失或不满足时| |---|---|---|---| |正确2.x Reasonix发行|必需|与固定studio代码对应|不混用npm1.x| |模型home/key和可达command|任务必需|子进程模型执行|先reasonix setup并核对路径| |同版DSH/ACP provider|委派必需|协议与插件加载|显式核对版本| |可丢弃cwd/明确权限|试用必需|限制修改与恢复|维持reject只读| #### 启动步骤 |步骤|执行者与成功判据|失败处理| |---|---|---| |配置正确发行及模型home|用户确认独立执行可用|修正路径/凭据| |装同版bundle并启开关|用户确认reasonix工具存在|不接受shell伪委派| |只读任务、取消和恢复|用户核对返回与进程|检查副作用再重试| ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 |阶段|现金与资源|人工与时间|未知| |---|---|---|---| |首次|正确发行、模型和ACP包|配置home/key、目录及版本|兼容与配置工时| |持续|子模型请求和重复上下文|委派、合并与独立测试|总调用成本和收益| |失败恢复|取消、重试与文件恢复|核对shell副作用及未验证改动|回收/恢复成功率与时间| #### 效果 |效果项|抽读支持|未知| |---|---|---| |DSH委派|ACP配置与作者报告|本轮运行兼容| |权限/取消|Policy分离、request context|所有前端和工具实际行为| |文件恢复|作者明确编辑工具范围|shell及完整工作区恢复| ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：多前端编码Agent与DSH ACP委派如何处理权限、取消和恢复边界？ ### Q01 · 根项目与DSH集成各是什么，贡献在哪里？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 根项目是Go编码Agent和多前端应用，Studio/终端/浏览器/ACP共用本地引擎，模型服务由用户配置；integrations/dsh-plugin只是其中一个配置bundle，不能把根项目写成普通DSH插件。目标是读取项目、修改文件和执行测试，合格结果是可核查的改动与验证。相对终端脚本，本体贡献是权限与多前端执行组织；DSH集成则复用宿主subagent-acp，用reasonix acp配置委派，没有新跨进程算法。README明确2.x Studio在开发而npm/main-v2是1.x维护线，当前固定studio源码不能用npm版本的成熟度或行为替代。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:64-74](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/README.md#L64-L74) 本地程序与远端模型、编辑和rewind边界
查看原文（11行） ```text ## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ```
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:87-119](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/README.md#L87-L119) 前端、DSH集成与版本线
查看原文（33行） ```text ## Four ways to use it - **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start. - **Terminal.** A full-screen text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts. - **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a web interface on your own machine. - **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can connect to `reasonix acp`. All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors. ## Use it from DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publishes a plugin index for it: 1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin markets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json` 2. Install "Reasonix subagent" from it. 3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one. Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in [Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness](./docs/DSH.md). ## Versions Reasonix ships on two lines. See the [version roadmap announcement](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/discussions/10748) for the reasoning behind the split. | Line | Branch | Status | Get it | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | [Studio releases](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases?q=studio-v&expanded=true) | | **Reasonix 1.x** | [`main-v2`](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/main-v2) | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · [desktop download](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) | - **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes, provider/API compatibility, updater and security fixes; its core architecture is no longer being extended. - **Want the new architecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving quickly; reports are welcome. ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[docs/DSH.md:16-25](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/docs/DSH.md#L16-L25) 作者说明配置委派与版本前提
查看原文（10行） ```text ## Purpose DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can delegate a task to any Agent Client Protocol agent through its `subagent-acp` provider. Reasonix speaks ACP with `reasonix acp`, so a Harness agent can hand work to Reasonix as a subagent with no code on either side, only configuration. Verified against `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` 0.2.1-rc.2, with a real DeepSeek model in the Reasonix child. ## Preconditions 1. Reasonix MUST be installed on the machine that runs `dsh`, and its model provider MUST be set up there: run `reasonix setup` once. 2. `reasonix` MUST be reachable by the command you configure (an absolute path is the safest). ```
#### 缺口 - 同模型编码任务交付及多前端一致性未验证 **影响**：不能确认委派正确、兼容或恢复成本 **进一步探讨**：在可丢弃项目用固定读代码任务验证ACP权限、取消、错误和产物，同模型直接执行作对照 ### Q02 · ACP委派与权限取消怎样接线？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 bundle注册subagent-acp provider指向reasonix acp，permission:reject，再注册tool-subagent并maxDepth:provider-managed。docs说明宿主自动答复子进程权限卡，reject取消，allow选择每次允许项，父UI不会逐卡展示；因此allow不是人逐次审批，隔离与子进程sandbox另配。Go permission模块将纯Policy与可交互Approver分离，有助跨前端保持规则，但注释明确非交互nil Approver保留自主allow语义，不能从“Ask”字样保证会有人确认。本项未检查所有调用者是否装Approver，不把注释当可利用漏洞。ACP flightSet按JSON-RPC requestId创建独立context取消，未知id忽略且结束回收，体现请求级取消隔离；它不单独证明工具副作用可撤销或子进程全回收。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml:1-14](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/integrations/dsh-plugin/cordis.patch.yml#L1-L14) provider/tool配置和默认权限
查看原文（14行） ```text - insert: - id: subagent-acp-reasonix name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp' config: providerName: reasonix command: reasonix args: ['acp'] permission: reject - id: tool-subagent-reasonix name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent' config: provider: reasonix toolName: reasonix maxDepth: provider-managed ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[internal/safety/permission/permission.go:1-27](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/internal/safety/permission/permission.go#L1-L27) Policy/Gate分工及决策
查看原文（27行） ```text // Package permission decides, per tool call, whether to allow it, deny it, or // ask the user first. The core is a pure Policy (rule evaluation, no I/O); a // Gate wraps a Policy with an optional interactive Approver and is what the // agent consults at execute time. Keeping rule evaluation pure makes it // trivially testable and keeps the agent independent of how "ask" is resolved. package permission import ( "context" "encoding/json" "reasonix/internal/contract/permrule" "strings" "reasonix/internal/base/shellparse" "reasonix/internal/safety/shellsafe" ) // Decision is the outcome of evaluating a tool call against a Policy. type Decision int const ( // Allow runs the tool without prompting. Allow Decision = iota // Ask defers to an interactive Approver (or, with none, resolves to Allow). Ask // Deny blocks the tool in every mode. Deny ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[internal/safety/permission/permission.go:576-611](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/internal/safety/permission/permission.go#L576-L611) 可选Approver及非交互语义
查看原文（36行） ```text // Approver resolves an Ask decision interactively. Implementations live in the // front-end (the chat TUI); a non-interactive run passes a nil Approver, which // the Gate treats as "allow" to preserve autonomous behaviour. type Approver interface { // Approve asks the user about a pending call. It returns whether to allow // it and whether to remember that choice as a new rule. A non-nil err (e.g. // the context was cancelled while waiting) aborts the turn. Approve(ctx context.Context, toolName, subject string, args json.RawMessage) (allow, remember bool, err error) } // ReasonedApprover is the optional extension used by frontends that can return // a denial reason to feed back to the model. type ReasonedApprover interface { ApproveWithReason(ctx context.Context, toolName, subject string, args json.RawMessage) (allow, remember bool, reason string, err error) } // PolicyReasonedApprover receives the explicit permission-rule provenance that // caused an Ask decision. Frontends can display it without duplicating Policy // matching logic; older Approver implementations remain source-compatible. type PolicyReasonedApprover interface { ApproveWithPolicyReason(ctx context.Context, toolName, subject string, args json.RawMessage, policyReason string) (allow, remember bool, reason string, err error) } // Gate is what the agent consults at execute time: a Policy plus an optional // Approver. It satisfies the agent's Gate interface structurally. type Gate struct { Policy Policy Approver Approver // OnRemember, when set, is invoked with a new allow rule the user chose to // remember (e.g. "Bash(go build)"), so the front-end can persist it. OnRemember func(rule string) } // NewGate wires a Policy to an Approver (nil for non-interactive use). func NewGate(p Policy, a Approver) *Gate { return &Gate{Policy: p, Approver: a} } ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[internal/frontend/acp/cancel_request.go:17-72](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/ec56ac27a34a47aa36f8748f93d08aaab21027fb/internal/frontend/acp/cancel_request.go#L17-L72) 独立请求上下文和取消
查看原文（56行） ```text ) // flightSet is the requests being served, so one can be cancelled by its id // without touching the others or the session they belong to. type flightSet struct { mu sync.Mutex m map[string]*flight } type flight struct { cancel context.CancelFunc cancelled atomic.Bool } func flightKey(id json.RawMessage) string { return string(bytes.TrimSpace(id)) } // begin registers a request and returns the context its handler runs under, the // flight to ask whether it was cancelled, and the function that ends it. func (s *flightSet) begin(ctx context.Context, id json.RawMessage) (context.Context, *flight, func()) { ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx) f := &flight{cancel: cancel} key := flightKey(id) s.mu.Lock() if s.m == nil { s.m = map[string]*flight{} } s.m[key] = f s.mu.Unlock() return ctx, f, func() { s.mu.Lock() if s.m[key] == f { delete(s.m, key) } s.mu.Unlock() cancel() } } // cancel ends the request with this id if it is still being served. An id that // is unknown, already answered or malformed is ignored: a notification has nowhere // to report anything. func (s *flightSet) cancel(params json.RawMessage) { var p struct { RequestID json.RawMessage `json:"requestId"` } if json.Unmarshal(params, &p) != nil || len(p.RequestID) == 0 { return } s.mu.Lock() f := s.m[flightKey(p.RequestID)] s.mu.Unlock() if f != nil { f.cancelled.Store(true) f.cancel() } } ```
